competency.title: Teach paired trials — few shot
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about paired trials using a paired baseline-candidate experiment. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: comparing different prompt or decode settings

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a paired baseline-candidate experiment.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report paired effect and confidence interval with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: comparing different prompt or decode settings.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of paired trials.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report paired effect and confidence interval against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for comparing different prompt or decode settings; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
